name: Shirakami-Sanchi
description: Shirakami-Sanchi is a mountain wilderness in northern Honshu, straddling the border of Aomori and Akita prefectures. It protects the last virgin stands of the beech forest that once blanketed northern Japan, in a core area of about 17,000 hectares with no marked trails. Black bears, serows, macaques and 87 bird species live beneath the canopy, and entering the heart of the forest requires permission.
